description: Transpose a line or chart of chord symbols by a number of semitones, keeping chord qualities and slash bass notes (C/E becomes D/F# up 2). Returns the transposed text with the original spacing and a link to the browser transposer. Works on chord symbols only: not audio, lyrics or notation files.

chords.description: Chord symbols separated by spaces or line breaks, as written on a lead sheet, for example "C G/B Am F".

preferFlats.description: Spell accidentals as flats (Bb, Eb) instead of sharps; use for flat keys such as F, Bb or Eb.

semitones.description: How far to move: positive is up, negative is down. 12 is one octave; capo 2 to concert pitch is -2.

name: transpose_chords

browserTool.description: Link to the matching free browser tool on clefdrills.com, to share with the user.

title: Transpose Chords
